notes:
CentraFlow 1.7.0 (build 13) — the supplied HTML design

A new interface based on your Black & White Redesign file: bundled Inter typography, white space, black actions, 2px corners, thin divider rows, outlined note tiles and a black next-class panel.

Home, Schedule, Subjects, Notes and Focus are the five bottom tabs. Open Menu for Settings, Classroom, grades, planning, study files, passage AI, flashcards, practice exams, topic connections, sign language, backup and updates. Home shows actual next-class timing; the Focus timer keeps running when switching tabs. Existing search, filters, editors, validations, source/consent controls and offline records remain available.

The Android launcher widget also uses the neutral palette. Saved subject-color values remain preserved. This update adds no schema migration, planner fixtures or database reset. The HTML's example grades, progress and AI replies are not seeded into the app. This is a light-theme implementation; dark mode is not included.

Verification: all 120 Flutter regression tests passed, including Focus tab persistence, Menu/Settings access, data storage, backups, note save/discard, independent class meetings, overlap warnings, offline Classroom and large-text/keyboard flows. Static analysis is clean. The actual Flutter gallery covers 71 route/state variants; its 101 exported images passed dimension, grayscale and widget-exception checks. APK identity, certificate, bundled font/license and twenty credited FSL clips are verified before publication.

Install over your existing CentraFlow app without uninstalling or clearing its data. Android will ask you to approve installation. Physical-phone upgrade, native bars/pickers/installer, widget rendering, video playback and background reminders still need device acceptance. FSL exercises remain a starter preview pending independent educator review. No camera translation, paid service, automatic AI upload or new backend deployment is included. Encrypted sync still requires its separately configured service.
